sermon.title: A Clear Sign a Church Has the Anointing of The Holy Spirit 12/31/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the clear sign of the Holy Spirit’s anointing is not outward displays but what Luke 4:18 describes. The Spirit coming “upon” leads to the next event: preaching to the poor in spirit, healing the brokenhearted, delivering captives, giving sight to the blind, freeing the bruised and proclaiming the acceptable year. He contrasts cold, lukewarm and theatrical churches and calls every believer to take part.
